item.title: Ilhabela and São Sebastião Island: Brazil’s wild side, just offshore
item.description: Ilhabela sits just off Brazil’s southeastern coast, close enough to the mainland to be easily reached, yet far enough to feel distinctly separate from it. item.description: After visiting Ilhabela the day before, I found myself once again heading toward another island off Brazil’s southeastern coast. But while Ilhabela balances tourism with conservation, Ilha Grande feels even wilder.
